integrity: The theorem is supported by a complete finite-dimensional spectral proof, exact rational checks through dimension six and five illustrative non-Hermitian matrix exponentials. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform coherent hypercube with two strictly positive local loss rates only; finite-time properties, disorder and other graph families are not established. The spectral projection framework is prior literature; independent novelty review remains outstanding.
title: Two absorbers on a quantum hypercube: antipodal redundancy and exact survival
